consider_special_mobs.label: Consider special mobs
consider_special_mobs.tooltip: Consider nearby special mobs to pull and in counts. These are mobs that spawn during specific times and weather.

max_mob_level.label: Max mob level
max_mob_level.tooltip: Max mob level to pull, helpful for use with special mobs or mobs with varied levels

max_euclidean_distance.label: Max euclidean distance
max_euclidean_distance.tooltip: Max euclidean distance to a mob before ignoring it, useful to stop yourself getting chained across the map when considering special mobs.

min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.label: Min distance to return to home
min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.tooltip: After combat, if you are further away from your starting point than this, you will walk back.

return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.label: Return to your starting point after combat
return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.tooltip: Starting point is determined by where you are stood when you press Start.

render_debug_lines.label: Render debug lines
render_debug_lines.tooltip: Render red lines to valid mobs out of combat and green lines to valid mobs in combat

render_debug_lines_while_not_running.label: Render debug lines while inactive
render_debug_lines_while_not_running.tooltip: Render the lines even while mob farmer is not running

maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.label: Maximum time to wait for Battle Bell
maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.tooltip: The maximum time you will wait for Battle Bell to be off of cooldown

minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.label: Minimum mobs to start
minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.tooltip: How many valid mobs need to be nearby to start the loop

minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.label: Minimum mobs to fight
minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.tooltip:
How many mobs to gather before stopping to fight them.
 Note if there are no more out of combat mobs around you, it will start combat regardless.

yield_to_pots.label: Stop for Magic Pots
yield_to_pots.tooltip:
Pause farming while a Magic Pot is live or about to spawn and hand over to the automator's Pots & Treasure mode (lead time follows the automator's pot settings).
When the pot is done the automator is stopped and the farmer walks back to its spot.
Does nothing while the automator is already running.

yield_to_treasure_hunt.label: Treasure Hunt on a timer
yield_to_treasure_hunt.tooltip:
On the interval below, pause farming and run one Treasure Hunt, then walk back to the spot.
Only starts when remaining bronze/silver meets the minimum % on Treasure Hunter; needs a Treasure Sight reading.

treasure_hunt_interval_minutes.label: Treasure Hunt interval (minutes)
treasure_hunt_interval_minutes.tooltip: Minutes between timed hunts. The first one is due this long after you press Start.

yield_to_crystal_buffs.label: Refresh crystal buffs when low
yield_to_crystal_buffs.tooltip:
With the Buffs module enabled, return to base camp after a fight when a crystal buff is below its reapply time, then teleport and walk back to the spot.
Waits 5 minutes before another buff trip.

cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.label: Cast Treasure Sight at the farm spot
cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.tooltip:
Switch to Freelancer, cast Treasure Sight to refresh the coffer counts, then switch back.
Needs Freelancer 10+.

treasure_sight_interval_minutes.label: Treasure Sight interval (minutes)
treasure_sight_interval_minutes.tooltip:
0 = after every fight (the previous behaviour).
Above 0: cast on this interval, also while waiting for enemies.
